descriptions.w3d_d41d_worm_explosion_response_8014860: Applies an explosion to a worm: if the worm's entry is active and within the blast radius, computes a power from the distance, takes the direction from the blast centre unless it equals the static zero vector, normalises it, tries up to four randomly spread directions with a landscape sweep and keeps the first clear one above water, applies the impulse; then, within the damage radius, applies at least one point of proportional damage.
